title: Rewrite every task with a plain-language goal and a real checklist
goal: Right now most tasks in the queue are unreadable unless you already know the codebase: the detail field is full of file names and shorthand, and there is no one-line statement of what the task actually achieves. This rewrites all of them so opening a task tells you what changes and for whom, and shows a checklist of what has to be true before it counts as done.
notes: Schema: tasks now carry goal (plain language), acceptance (checklist), notes (runner detail). See the contract in queue/bin/runner-prompt.md. Work through queue/tasks/*/*.json for every task whose status is not done or dropped. Read each task title, notes and log to infer the real intent; when the intent is genuinely unclear, say so in the goal rather than inventing one. Do not change titles, ids, priority or seq. Commit as one change.
acceptance: Every open task has a goal field of one or two plain sentences with no file names, class names or page ids
Every open task has at least two acceptance items, each one verifiable by looking or running something
The original technical text is preserved in the notes field, not deleted
Opening any task on the dashboard shows the goal first, the checklist second, and the working detail collapsed last

log.note: rewrote goal + acceptance on all 25 open tasks; notes left untouched so the technical text survives
verified in a browser: the task dialog renders goal, then Done when, then a collapsed Working detail disclosure
